answer: Each identity is hashed into one submission slot per epoch, and only answers landing inside their own slot carry full weight, so total weight is limited by the number of slots. A farm of n identities crowds into few slots and must split one slot's weight among many accounts, while buying more distinct slots means more real, separate identities. Like a river held back at a ledge, where an umber stain marks the line it may not pass, each slot has fixed capacity.
